8429._note: PS Blacksmith rework 2026-08-09. Id, level requirement and job list taken from the in-game client tooltip (2026-08-09 screenshot: 'Whirling_Hammer' / 'Whirling Hammer [1]' (8429), Level Requirement 60, Jobs: Blacksmith), which OVERRIDES the rework PDF on two points — the PDF said level 70 and did not restrict the job. tools.payonstories.com/api/pc/item still returns 'No data' for it, so the client is the authoritative source here. 'Gain 1 SP each time a monster is killed by a physical melee attack' is not a damage term and is not modeled.

_comment_95xxx: The reserved 95xxx block is currently EMPTY. It exists for items announced in a rework PDF that are not obtainable yet and that tools.payonstories.com/api/pc/item returns 'No data' for, so there is no real id to key them by; re-key them to the published id once they land (a share link that equips one will need the item re-picked). Both 2026-08-09 weapons have now made that move: Whirling Hammer to 8429 (in-game client tooltip) and Giant Pestle to 8430 (item API, 2026-08-10).

Base LUK and base DEX 60-79 give +3 ATK per Pharmacy level; 80+ raises that to +12 per level (the PDF states the 80+ figure is the TOTAL bonus, not an addition). The Potion Pitcher extra-target chance (5% / 20%) is a support effect with no damage term. Re-keyed 2026-08-10 from the provisional 95002 to its real id 8430, published by tools.payonstories.com/api/pc/item; every stat here (Mace, ATK 100, weight 130, weapon level 3, level req 58, 1 slot, Alchemist) matches that entry.
